message.reasoning:
The user is playing Monopoly and must decide whether to mortgage property or declare bankruptcy.

Mortgaging all three properties yields only $160, leaving a $274 shortfall. The user cannot raise enough cash and must declare bankruptcy.

Mortgaging first would leave the creditor with mortgaged properties, which are less valuable. Declaring bankruptcy immediately is preferable.

Mortgaging before bankruptcy would burden the creditor with 10% interest to unmortgage those properties. The net economic value transferred remains roughly the same, but the creditor would pay that interest instead of receiving cash.

Only p2 remains in the game. Declaring bankruptcy is the correct action because the user cannot raise enough cash.
